The “Increase Self Confidence” Meditation leverages Agesta’s sacred codes to instigate positive life changes. For visible impact, it is recommended to engage in this meditation for a duration of 9, 15, or 21 days.

For more immediate benefits, it is advisable to complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions prior to beginning.

Sacred codes are numerical sequences believed to help individuals reach higher frequencies, manifest their desires, and promote healing. These sequences, introduced by figures like Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), are said to originate from beings of light and work as a spiritual technology to uplift human consciousness.

To activate a sacred code, repeat the numerical sequence—either in your mind or aloud—while you are in a meditative state. With its unique combination of numerology, meditation, and energy healing, this practice has received praise from many practitioners and continues to be an intriguing tool in modern esoteric practices.
